review_scope: Primary independently read the complete first-pass report and every required core file: env.json, task.json, controls.json, generator, browser JavaScript, CSS, grader, verifier and solver. Shared verifier helper already read.
decision: Change temporal to No in full mode, making both modes non-temporal at all five levels. The pointer path is an untimed drag from one static module to the static empty slot; only the release updates the board. There is no sustained effect while the pointer is still, minimum duration, moving target, or dependence on past hidden state. Monotonic timestamps and the ordinary session bound are not temporal capability evidence. Keep 3D for functional elevation/stair connections, reasoning/planning for consequential empty-slot and route reconfiguration, and exploration No for the initially exposed geometry/rules.

rationale_clarifications.temporal: Full-mode dragging is untimed spatial placement. The board changes only on release; pointermove draws a preview. Both modes permit a solution from the current static board without interpreting change or controlling duration.

additional_source_evidence.claim: Pointermove previews a source-to-pointer line; the static endpoint on pointerup triggers a discrete slide. Steps are also immediate state changes.
Event time checks impose only monotonicity and a 900-second session bound, not an action-duration or timing-window requirement.

uncertainties: Source review only; no new gameplay, quality calibration, real-time or difficulty classification.
